Symbolic AI

SHRDLU grounds language in a small world

Language, reasoning, and action were integrated in a constrained blocks world.

Terry Winograd

AI topics

Explore related entries. Larger tags appear on more entries.

Symbolic AINatural language processingReasoningKnowledge representation

The contribution

Winograd described a system that interpreted instructions and questions with reference to objects and actions in a small simulated environment. The work demonstrated how syntax, semantic representations, and domain knowledge could cooperate in a conversational system.

What this does not establish

The blocks world was deliberately restricted. Success there did not imply general language understanding in open environments.

Why this date?

This timeline uses the 1971 MIT thesis/report, rather than a development date or the 1972 book.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
